exempt_class.instructions: Which exempt class does the ENTIRE runtime surface fall into, judging only from the hunks?

criteria.revert: the change reverses a prior change
criteria.message-string-only: only user-facing message/log strings change, no logic
criteria.covered-by-existing-test: an existing in-tree test the PR does not modify covers the change
criteria.none: none of these — a real behavioral change needing its own test

is_genuine_revert.instructions: The diff genuinely reverses a prior change (a real reversal, not lookalike code).

criteria.true: a genuine reversal of a prior change

existing_test_covers_change.instructions: An existing in-tree test near the change (which the PR does not modify) plausibly covers the changed behavior.

criteria.true: an existing untouched test plausibly covers the change
criteria.false: no existing untouched test plausibly covers the change
